title: Co-Recursive Semantic Self-Extension: A Mathematical Foundation for Open-Ended Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.31097v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced through scale, data, and computation, yet remains bounded by its representational framework. We ask what makes intelligence open-ended. Every inferential system selects meaningful distinctions, limiting what it can learn. Within a fixed purpose, performance reaches a ceiling set by its semantic domain. Teleological succession, in which purposes arise from earlier ones, faces a similar limit: Boolean-closed purpose-transformations exhaust their reachable semantic territory. We shift from purposes to inferential systems. Drawing on Kant and G\"odel, we model cognitive states as partial evaluations over a formal language. Unresolved propositions may be undecided or undecidable. Reasoning can resolve the former but not the latter, leaving a frontier for extension. translated_title: 协递归语义自我扩展：开放式智能的数学基础
translated_abstract: 人工智能通过规模、数据和计算取得了长足进步，但仍然受限于其表示框架。我们探究是什么使智能具有开放性。每个推理系统都会选择有意义的区分，从而限制了它能够学习的内容。在固定的目的之下，性能会达到由其语义域设定的上限。目的论式的相继演进——即新目的从旧目的中产生——也面临类似的限制：布尔封闭的目的变换会穷尽其可到达的语义疆域。我们将视角从目的转向推理系统。借鉴康德和哥德尔的思想，我们将认知状态建模为对形式语言的部分求值。未解决的命题可能是未定的或不可判定的。推理可以解决前者，但无法解决后者，这为扩展留下了前沿。对不可判定命题的非平凡归约会暴露出不可判定的中间前提，而这些前提的反思性具体化支持多种……
tldr: 该论文借鉴康德与哥德尔思想，将认知状态建模为形式语言上的部分求值，提出“协递归语义自我扩展”的数学框架，通过对不可判定中间前提的反思性具体化，使智能系统能够突破固定目的与布尔封闭目的变换的语义边界，为开放式智能奠定数学基础。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mathematical foundation for open-ended intelligence by modeling cognitive states as partial evaluations over a formal language (drawing on Kant and Gödel), where the reflective reification of undecidable intermediate premises enables co-recursive semantic self-extension beyond fixed purposes and their Boolean-closed transformations.
